title: Timescape tracker distance and same-object reduction sensitivity
faithful_claim: The tracker wall-observer distance differs from bare evolution; historical SN comparisons depend on cuts, reductions and overlapping object selections.

equations.expression: gamma_bar=dt/dtau; H=gamma_bar H_bar-gamma_bar^{-1} dgamma_bar/dtau; Omega_m=gamma_bar^3 Omega_bar_m
equations.definitions: t volume-average time; tau wall-observer proper time; bare and dressed H/Omega have distinct meanings.
equations.domain: Two-scale timescape effective observer prescription; not an exact inhomogeneous spacetime proof.

equations.definitions: Tracker void fraction fv(t), dressed observed redshift z and volume-average time t; source geometric units need c to give Mpc.
equations.domain: Verified tracker mapping and null-cone convention required; never insert a guessed FLRW z(t).

assumptions: Two-scale dust averaging; flat walls and curved voids.
Observer lapse and null-cone dressing; effective metrics, not exact spacetime solutions.

minimal_test.question: Dressed tracker distance implementation and conditional same-object reduction/cut sensitivity; not the full inhomogeneous theory.
observables: Closed-form versus independently integrated d_L at matching wall redshifts.
Conditional distance-modulus residual/profile changes across preregistered common-object selections and z cuts, including 0.024 and 0.033 as source variants.
Bare and dressed H/q printed separately if derivatives are implemented.
minimal_test.scope: A verified tracker f_v(t), gamma(t), z(t) and observer convention; identified common-event release rows, redshift frames, reduction/calibration/selection, covariance and common offset convention. Inputs are currently unresolved. All choices remain to be registered; no inferred values are inserted into a runnable request.

simplifications: General Buchert initial-condition solution and proof of an exact underlying spacetime.
Detailed line-of-sight void/wall sampling and local below-SHS predictions.
Full light-curve retraining/refitting, extinction priors, selection/population evolution and any absolute H0 inference without calibration.
data_dependencies: SN Ia distance moduli and light-curve parameters from Riess07 Gold, Union, Constitution, MLCS17, MLCS31, SDSS-II, SALT2, Union2, and CSP; dataset versions and selection differ.

The published SALT/Union and SALT-II/Union2 distances and uncertainties embed homogeneous FLRW/constant-w reduction assumptions; the paper's adapted simple cosfitter changes the luminosity-distance relation but does not redo all photometric inference.
MLCS2k2 results depend on training/calibration, extinction-law RV choices (including 1.7, 2.18, 3.1), priors, and excluded events; some training objects lie below the proposed SHS.
Bayes factors depend on stated priors (typically 0.01≤Ω_m0≤0.95 and, where relevant, 55≤H₀≤75 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹); H₀ and SN absolute magnitude normalization are degenerate without external calibration.
The proposed SHS redshift threshold derives from the model's assumed ≈100 h⁻¹ Mpc coarse-graining scale; exact cuts change sample membership and evidence.
The approximate WMAP/BAO comparison in Figure 4 relies on sound-horizon angular scale and effective BAO scale matching and carries un-reworked standard-model data-reduction assumptions.
unknowns: Tracker mapping/limits beyond this paper and independent numerical reference.
Raw photometric inputs, full selection/extinction priors, covariance and cross-reduction dependence.
Model-consistent BAO/CMB reductions and modern observational constraints.
verification_gates: Keep numerical verification, observation lineage, inference validation and scientific interpretation as separate gates.
Freeze reference cases and consumer-derived error allocations before accepting outputs; no production tolerance is invented here.
Historical fit values are comparison targets only after matching release, likelihood, priors and implementation.
Acquire/review the primary tracker mapping; reject guessed FLRW time-redshift substitutions.
Check dimensions, dt/dtau, d_L(0)=0 and observer H0 small-z normalization in the model averaged validity domain; validate analytic/quadrature agreement.
Retain common-object identity/order; apply identical declared cuts to comparisons; do not concatenate overlapping reductions as independent data.
Identify nuisance normalization separately from absolute M/H0. Profile-score agreement is not Bayesian evidence; evidence needs declared proper priors and nuisance measure.
A causal claim about reduction dependence needs full model-consistent light-curve/source-selection reanalysis or a bounded bias demonstration.
falsification: Inconsistent bare/dressed mapping, incorrect c restoration or failure of analytic/quadrature agreement rejects the implementation. A faithful data comparison could reject a specified TS parameter/reduction variant; an unexplained fitter difference alone establishes neither TS nor a universal astrophysical correction.

consumer.capability_status: No compiled EDE, NEDE or timescape model at inspected revision; all listed scientific capabilities unqualified.

blockers: Only flat_flrw geometry and LCDM/CPL/constant_q/fixed_q5 expansion specs exist; no timescape lapse or dressed null-cone projection.
Current supernova.profile is a conditional single-offset relative profile, not SALT/MLCS retraining or Bayesian evidence.
photometry.predict has a rectangular constant-rest-luminosity source, no SN spectra/color/populations, noise, selection or detector inference.
No recipe runner; arbitrary equations cannot be executed from JSON.

qualification.reason: Source/design review only. No compiled model, admitted data, numerical run or paper reproduction.
